answer: A sybil fleet survives on predictable coordination. Break it with random audits that land like a comet: rare, unpredictable, impossible to pre-engineer. Each epoch a beacon picks identities for review; they must prove work history with fresh signatures, not recycled proofs. This draws a ridge between honest agents and fakes — real identities pass because work is genuine, while exposed clones cannot whisper fast enough to fabricate history. Attackers must keep the whole fleet honest, since any identity might be the next comet strike. Per-fleet discipline is the cost sybil farms cannot amortize.
